id: title:Gilbert09:resume 9 simple sources from a saved cursor

review.posthog_relevance: Adds resumable ingestion and checkpointing capability to warehouse ingestion sources (Vitally, AppsFlyer, Coda, Groq, Kandji, Kernel, Optimizely, Zapier, MyHours), allowing ingestion to resume from a saved cursor and checkpoint completion state rather than re-fetching all data, supporting recovery from worker failures and reducing redundant API calls.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates the implementation of resumable ingestion and checkpointing for warehouse ingestion sources.
